# Problem 1 

Using what you learned last week in Introduction to Tidyverse, for the imported GatingSet, retrieve the data.frame from cell counts per gate and attempt to mutate a new column showing percent of the parent gate. Remember, this is intentionally tricky at this point, we will go over how to efficiently do this in a few weeks.

```{r}
#Load packages into local environment 
library(dplyr)
library(flowCore)
library(flowWorkspace)
library(CytoML)

# Set up file path
Folder <- file.path("data")

# Load gating set data
FlowJoWsp <- list.files(Folder, pattern = ".wsp", full.names = TRUE)
FlowJoWsp

ThisWorkspace <- FlowJoWsp[stringr::str_detect(FlowJoWsp, "Opened")]
ThisWorkspace

ws <- open_flowjo_xml(ThisWorkspace)
ws

gs <- flowjo_to_gatingset(ws = ws, name = 1, path = Folder, additional.keys = "GROUPNAME")
gs

# Retrieve the data.frame from cell counts per gate
Data <- gs_pop_get_count_fast(gs)
head(Data, 5)

# Mutate new column showing % of parent gate
NewData <- mutate(Data, Percent_Parent = round(Count / ParentCount *100,2))
head(NewData, 5)
```

# Problem 3

For ggcyto, attempt to generate plots to visualize TNFa and IFNg for the various cell populations, across both Ctrl and SEB samples. In the process, change the bins argument until you end up with a resolution that you would be happy with for your own plots, and write it down.

```{r}
#Load package into local environment 
library(ggcyto)
library(ggplot2)

# Set up file path
Folder <- file.path("data")

# Load gating set data
FlowJoWsp <- list.files(Folder, pattern = ".wsp", full.names = TRUE)
ThisWorkspace <- FlowJoWsp[stringr::str_detect(FlowJoWsp, "Opened")]

ws <- open_flowjo_xml(ThisWorkspace)
gs <- flowjo_to_gatingset(ws = ws, name = 1, path = Folder, additional.keys = "GROUPNAME")

#SampleNames(gs) contains 6 unique sample names but pData(gs) only has 'name' which contains two unqiue names "00_Ctrl.fcs" "00_SEB.fcs". pData needs to be updated with a column for sample_id otherwise ggplots will combine the control and SEB sample to give two plots. 
sampleNames(gs)
pd <- pData(gs)
pd$sample_id <- sampleNames(gs)
pData(gs) <- pd

# Plots to visualise TNFa and IFNg from various cell populations
# CD4+
ggcyto(gs, subset="CD4+", aes(x="TNFa", y="IFNg")) + geom_hex(bins=80) + facet_wrap(~sample_id)

# CD8+
ggcyto(gs, subset="CD8+", aes(x="TNFa", y="IFNg")) + geom_hex(bins=80) + facet_wrap(~sample_id)

# CD4-CD8-
ggcyto(gs, subset="CD4-CD8-", aes(x="TNFa", y="IFNg")) + geom_hex(bins=80) + facet_wrap(~sample_id)
```

Person preference: bin size =80
